scenes.description: Raising Hands with Benny Saying I Know the Answer
Laughing Merrily over a Funny Illustrated Joke Book
Arriving at Grandma Cozy Country House with Big Hugs

character_line.en: Teacher asked a riddle! Who can solve it?
character_line.zh: 老師出了一個謎語！誰能夠解開它？

options.en: I know the answer! Let me raise my hand!
options.zh: 我知道答案！讓我來舉手回答！

options.hint: 知道答案用動詞「know（知道）」喔！
自信舉起手說「I know the answer!」吧！

character_line.en: Bingo! You got it right! How did you know that?
character_line.zh: 答對了！你回答得完全正確！你是怎麼知道的呢？

options.en: I read and remember it in our science book!
options.zh: 我在我們的自然課本裡讀過並記住了！

options.hint: 分享你在書裡讀過且記住「remember」喔！
告訴 Benny 閱讀能讓人學到好多知識！

character_line.en: Look at page ten of this comic! Why is the puppy wearing glasses?
character_line.zh: 看這本漫畫的第十頁！為什麼小狗戴著眼鏡？

options.en: Haha! It is so funny! I laugh out loud!
options.zh: 哈哈！太好笑了！我都大聲笑出來了！

options.hint: 覺得好笑發笑用動詞「laugh（大笑）」喔！
跟 Benny 一起哈哈大笑開心地享受幽默！

character_line.en: Laughing together brings so much joy! Let's read another page!
character_line.zh: 一起笑帶來好多歡樂！我們再來讀下一頁吧！

options.en: Let's turn the page and see what happens next!
options.zh: 我們翻開下一頁，看看接下來發生什麼事！

options.hint: 提議一起做某事可以用「Let's...」喔！
興奮地翻到下一頁繼續看漫畫吧！

character_line.en: Here is Grandma's house with flowers! Where does Grandma live?
character_line.zh: 到了外婆滿是花朵的家！外婆住在哪裡呢？

options.en: She lives in a cozy country house near the woods!
options.zh: 她住在樹林旁邊一棟溫馨的鄉村木屋裡！

options.hint: 居住在某個地方用動詞「live（居住）」喔！
告訴 Benny 外婆住在樹林旁的溫馨鄉村！

character_line.en: Grandma is opening the door with warm cookies! What should we do?
character_line.zh: 外婆拿著烤好的熱餅乾開門了！我們該做什麼？

options.en: Give her a big warm hug and say "We love you"!
options.zh: 給她一個大大的溫暖擁抱，並說「我們愛您」！

options.hint: 用溫暖的擁抱「hug」與表達愛意「love」對待外婆喔！
給親愛的外婆一個大擁抱吧！
